question: Who wins the Texas Senate race in 2026
turn_text: Right now, Tallarico, even if he is slow to recover from either the flu and or whiteness, which he lamented was a contagious disease back in 2020. Look, I think the fact that outside Republican groups are spending, I think last time I added up some of the big ones, it was in the neighborhood of like $230 million. Yes, Texas is an expensive state, lots of media markets, but like they're not spending that money if Ken Paxton is ahead. So, you know, at minimum, this thing is really close. I think his long absence from the trail probably was a sign of the fact that Tallarico feels like he's ahead and he just wants the election to happen. Doesn't want to have any last-second gaffes or mistakes or something like that. So I'd rather be Tallarico.
host_quote: Who would you rather be? James Tallarico or Ken Paxton?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Texas US Senate general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
